voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: On a June night in nineteen ninety-two, in Springfield, Missouri, three women arrived home from a pair of graduation parties.
A mother, forty-seven. Her daughter, nineteen. The daughter's friend, eighteen.
By morning, all three were gone.
Their cars were in the driveway. Their purses were inside. The porch light was still on. There was no sign of struggle.
Thirty years later, no bodies have been found. No one has been charged.
